# v0.3.0

- **Check for Updates…** in the app menu, and **Check for Updates** at the bottom right of the window: shows what changed in a newer version and, when you choose to install it, downloads it, verifies its signature, replaces the app and relaunches it. The app also checks once a day and tells you when a new version is out; it never installs one without you.
- The app now goes online, only for this check: it reads the list of updates (`appcast.xml`) from GitHub, and downloads a new version only when you choose to install it. Nothing about your files is sent.
- The version link at the bottom right of the window is now **Check for Updates**, with the version in its tooltip; **Help → Open Latest Release…** still opens the release page.
- Install this version from the DMG once; after that, install new versions with **Check for Updates…**.
